sn46.52:1.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃsu.
sn46.52:1.3: atippago kho tāva sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya carituṃ
sn46.52:1.4: yannūna mayaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyāmāti.
sn46.52:2.1: atha kho te bhikkhū yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu
sn46.52:2.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etadavocuṃ
sn46.52:3.1: samaṇo āvuso gotamo sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti
sn46.52:3.2: etha tumhe bhikkhave pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe satta bojjhaṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvethāti.
sn46.52:3.3: mayampi kho āvuso sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desema
sn46.52:3.4: etha tumhe āvuso pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe satta bojjhaṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvethāti.
sn46.52:3.5: idh no āvuso ko viseso ko adhippāyaso kinnānākaraṇaṃ samaṇassa vā gotamassa amhākaṃ vā yadidaṃ dhammadesanāya vā dhammadesanaṃ anusāsaniyā vā anusāsananti.
sn46.52:4.1: atha kho te bhikkhū tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandiṃsu nappaṭikkosiṃsu
sn46.52:4.3: bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmāti.
sn46.52:4.4: atha kho te bhikkhū sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn46.52:5.1: idha mayaṃ bhante pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pavisimha.
sn46.52:5.3: atippago kho tāva sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya carituṃ
sn46.52:5.4: yannūna mayaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyāmāti.
sn46.52:5.5: atha kho mayaṃ bhante yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkamimha upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodimha
sn46.52:5.6: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdimha. ekamantaṃ nisinne kho amhe bhante te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etadavocuṃ
sn46.52:6.1: samaṇo āvuso gotamo sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti etha tumhe bhikkhave pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe satta bojjhaṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvethāti.
sn46.52:6.2: mayampi kho āvuso sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desema
sn46.52:6.3: etha tumhe āvuso pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe satta bojjhaṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvethāti.
sn46.52:6.4: idha no āvuso ko viseso ko adhippāyaso kinnānākaraṇaṃ samaṇassa vā gotamassa amhākaṃ vā yadidaṃ dhammadesanāya vā dhammadesanaṃ anusāsaniyā vā anusāsananti.
sn46.52:7.1: atha kho mayaṃ bhante tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandimha nappaṭikkosimha anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamimha
sn46.52:7.2: bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmāti.
sn46.52:8.1: evaṃvādino bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evamassu vacanīyā
sn46.52:8.2: atthi panāvuso pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma pañca nīvaraṇā dasa honti satta bojjhaṅgā catuddasāti.
sn46.52:8.3: evaṃ puṭṭhā bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā na ceva sampāyissanti uttariñca vighātaṃ āpajjissanti.
sn46.52:8.6: nāhantaṃ bhikkhave passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya yo imesaṃ pañhānaṃ veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheyya aññatra tathāgatena vā tathāgatasāvakena vā ito vā pana sutvā.
sn46.52:9.1: katamo ca bhikkhave pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma pañca nīvaraṇā dasa honti.
sn46.52:9.2: yadapi bhikkhave ajjhattaṃ kāmacchando tadapi nīvaraṇaṃ yadapi bahiddhā kāmacchando tadapi nīvaraṇaṃ
sn46.52:9.3: kāmacchandanīvaraṇanti iti hidaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati. tadamināpetaṃ pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti.
sn46.52:9.4: yadapi bhikkhave ajjhattaṃ byāpādo tadapi nīvaraṇaṃ yadapi bahiddhā byāpādo tadapi nīvaraṇaṃ
sn46.52:9.5: byāpādanīvaraṇanti iti hidaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati. tadamināpetaṃ pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti.
sn46.52:9.6: yadapi bhikkhave thīnaṃ tadapi nīvaraṇaṃ yadapi middhaṃ tadapi nīvaraṇaṃ
sn46.52:9.7: thīnamiddhanīvaraṇanti iti hidaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati. tadamināpetaṃ pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti.
sn46.52:9.8: yadapi bhikkhave uddhaccaṃ tadapi nīvaraṇaṃ yadapi kukkuccaṃ tadapi nīvaraṇaṃ
sn46.52:9.9: uddhaccakukkuccanīvaraṇanti iti hidaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati. tadamināpetaṃ pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti.
sn46.52:9.10: yadapi bhikkhave ajjhattaṃ dhammesu vicikicchā tadapi nīvaraṇaṃ yadapi bahiddhā dhammesu vicikicchā tadapi nīvaraṇaṃ
sn46.52:9.11: vicikicchānīvaraṇanti iti hidaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati. tadamināpetaṃ pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti.
sn46.52:9.12: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma pañca nīvaraṇā dasa honti.
sn46.52:10.1: katamo ca bhikkhave pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma satta bojjhaṅgā catuddasa honti.
sn46.52:10.2: yadapi bhikkhave ajjhattaṃ dhammesu sati tadapi satisambojjhaṅgo yadapi bahiddhā dhammesu sati tadapi satisambojjhaṅgo
sn46.52:10.3: satisambojjhaṅgoti iti hidaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati. tadamināpetaṃ pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti.
sn46.52:11.1: yadapi bhikkhave ajjhattaṃ dhammesu paññāya pavicinati paricarati parivīmaṃsamāpajjati tadapi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo yadapi bahiddhā dhammesu paññāya pavicinati paricarati parivīmaṃsamāpajjati tadapi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo
sn46.52:11.2: dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgoti iti hidaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati. tadamināpetaṃ pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti.
sn46.52:12.1: yadapi bhikkhave kāyikaṃ viriyaṃ tadapi viriyasambojjhaṅgo yadapi cetasikaṃ viriyaṃ tadapi viriyasambojjhaṅgo
sn46.52:12.2: viriyasambojjhaṅgoti iti hidaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati. tadamināpetaṃ pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti.
sn46.52:13.1: yadapi bhikkhave savitakkasavicārā pīti tadapi pītisambojjhaṅgo yadapi avitakkāvicārā pīti tadapi pītisambojjhaṅgo
sn46.52:13.2: pītisambojjhaṅgoti iti hidaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati. tadamināpetaṃ pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti.
sn46.52:14.1: yadapi bhikkhave kāyappassaddhi tadapi passaddhisambojjhaṅgo yadapi cittappassaddhi tadapi passaddhisambojjhaṅgo
sn46.52:14.2: passaddhisambojjhaṅgoti iti hidaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati. tadamināpetaṃ pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti.
sn46.52:15.1: yadapi bhikkhave savitakko savicāro samādhi tadapi samādhisambojjhaṅgo yadapi avitakko avicāro samādhi tadapi samādhisambojjhaṅgo
sn46.52:15.2: samādhisambojjhaṅgoti iti hidaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati. tadamināpetaṃ pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti.
sn46.52:16.1: yadapi bhikkhave ajjhattaṃ dhammesu upekkhā tadapi upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo yadapi bahiddhā dhammesu upekkhā tadapi upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo
sn46.52:16.2: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgoti iti hidaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati. tadamināpetaṃ pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti.
sn46.52:16.3: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma satta bojjhaṅgā catuddasāti.
